title: MANAGE_SELL_OFFER fails with MANAGE_SELL_OFFER_BUY_NOT_AUTHORIZED
pattern: A transaction whose MANAGE_SELL_OFFER operation fails at apply is still written into the closed ledger: its fee is charged, its sequence number is consumed, and nothing it did is kept. The result carries the operation's code (buy_not_authorized). Buying ARQ into an unauthorized trustline.

hazards.placement: offer buying into an unauthorized trustline

facts.says: No operation changed state: the operation meta is empty.
The fee is still charged: the fee source changes in fee processing.
